home.lead: Pick your exam, upload a photo, and download a file guaranteed to fit — no specs to memorise. Everything runs on your device; your images never leave your phone.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search your exam (e.g. SSC CGL, IBPS PO)
home.customDesc: Not listed? Enter the width, height and KB range yourself.
home.noResults: No exam matches that. Try the Custom option.
exam.unverifiedWarning: These values are a template and not yet verified. Confirm them against the official notification before you rely on the output.
exam.genericWarning: We haven't added this exam's official specs yet, so these are generic placeholder values. Check the official notification and use Custom mode with the exact numbers.
upload.hint: JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC from your phone
crop.title: Crop to fit

result.title: Validation
quality.tooSmall: Your photo is smaller than the required size, so it had to be enlarged — detail may look soft. Use the original camera photo, not a forwarded/WhatsApp copy.
quality.padded: File was slightly padded to meet the minimum size (pixels unchanged).
result.overrideWarn: This doesn't meet every rule. Download anyway?
crossPromo: Tailoring a resume for private jobs too? Try Quick AI
privacy: Your images never leave your device.
